vocabulary: Words by topic, with pictures and sound.
expressions: What people really say, and when.

fr.name: French
fr.tagline: French as it is spoken, from your first bonjour to C1.

can.a1: Greet people, introduce yourself, get through a shop or a café.
can.a2: Handle simple exchanges, talk about the past, make plans.
can.b1: Give opinions, tell stories, follow people who do not slow down.
can.b2: Understand what is meant, not only what is said: tone, nuance, register.
can.c1: Move between registers and argue a point with precision.

eng.name: English
eng.native: အင်္ဂလိပ်စာ
eng.tagline: Stories, pictures and everyday English, with Burmese when you need it.

can.pre-a1: Know the letters and sounds, and your first words.
can.a1: Talk about yourself, your family, school, animals and food.
can.a2: Describe your day, tell a simple story, ask for things politely.
can.b1: Explain, retell and learn school subjects in English.
can.b2: Read longer texts, write essays, discuss ideas.
can.c1: Read literature, argue a case, research and present.

jap.name: Japanese
jap.tagline: Spoken Japanese by ear: no writing to learn. English and Burmese support.

can.a1: Greet, introduce yourself, ask for things, count, shop.
can.a2: Daily conversation, plans, permission; polite and plain speech.
can.b1: Explain, give opinions, workplace talk, the telephone, basic keigo.
can.b2: Nuance, indirectness, formal situations, longer discussion.

kor.name: Korean
kor.tagline: Spoken Korean by ear, with Hangul beside every line. English and Burmese support.

can.a1: Greet, introduce yourself, ask for things, count, shop.
can.a2: Daily conversation, plans, permission; polite and casual speech.
can.b1: Explain, give opinions, workplace talk, the telephone, basic honorifics.
can.b2: Nuance, indirectness, formal situations, longer discussion.
